limits.name: Scene::c_MaxEntities
limits.comment: EnTT identifiers have a 20-bit index, so a registry holds at most this many live entities.

limits.name: Scene::c_MaxSubSceneMillisecondsPerFrame
limits.comment: How long an update of a scene may spend creating and destroying the entities of sub-scenes at most, together (besides SceneSettings::MaxEntitiesInstantiatedPerFrame and MaxEntitiesDestroyedPerFrame, and within the frame's SceneWorkBudget): they create and destroy them in chunks and stop once this much time went by.

limits.name: Scene::c_MaxInterpolatedSpeed
limits.comment: A step longer than this speed times the time it simulated is a teleport, never blended: box3d's maximum linear speed (b3WorldDef::maximumLinearSpeed, 400 m/s; PhysicsWorld keeps box3d's default, which Physics.Settings checks).

limits.name: PhysicsCapacitySettings::c_MaxBodiesLimit
limits.comment: The largest values a scene may ask for, whether its file or a command sets them. A world's room is bounded by MaxBodies (its bodies wait beyond it); a scene holds at most Scene::c_MaxEntities (2^20 - 1) entities, so 2^21 bodies have room for all of them, with the automatic sizing's headroom. box3d reserves the room at once up to PhysicsWorld::c_MaxBodiesReservedAtCreation and grows its storage beyond it while bodies come.

limits.name: ProjectSceneTiming::c_MaxStepsLimit
limits.comment: The most steps an update runs at a project rate is the steps of 2/15 s at that rate (GetMaxSteps), the time SceneSettings::MaxFixedStepsPerFrame's default of 8 covers at 60; never more than this.

limits.name: WorldData::c_MaxExtent
limits.comment: Every cell lies within this distance of the origin, in X and in Z (1,000 km).

limits.name: WorldData::c_SupportedExtent
limits.comment: What float32 positions support at 2-4 mm precision: worlds are supported within 20 km of the origin (world.cook warns about cells beyond it). Origin rebasing is later work.

limits.name: WorldCellKey::c_MaxCoordinate
limits.comment: Cell coordinates a key can pack: every cell of a valid world fits (WorldData::c_MaxExtent with the smallest cells).

limits.name: c_MaxBodyCoordinate
limits.comment: box3d computes in single precision and asserts on coordinates beyond B3_HUGE (1e5 m at one unit per meter): bodies whose world position is farther from the origin wait like bodies with a degenerate transform.

limits.name: PhysicsWorld::c_MaxBodiesReservedAtCreation
limits.comment: The most room box3d reserves when a world is created, unless the automatic room of the scene's bodies is larger (about 280 MB of bodies and 65 MB of contacts by EstimateReservedBytes): a room given beyond it counts for growth only, and box3d grows its storage as the bodies come, so that the largest room a scene may ask for does not reserve gigabytes up front.

limits.name: ProjectSettingsValues::c_MaxStoredBytes
limits.comment: The bound of the stored form (compact JSON): the project file and the manifest's settings hold at most this.
